summary.text: Val Peterson is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 56, where he has served since 2011, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A former Utah National Guard colonel, he earned a Ph.D. from Brigham Young University and worked as a vice president at Utah Valley University.

paragraphs.text: Peterson graduated from Moscow High School in 1981.

He earned a B.A. in communications and public relations, an M.A. in mass communications and a Ph.D. in educational leadership from Brigham Young University, and an M.S. in strategic studies from the U.S. Army War College.
He served in the Utah National Guard, reaching the rank of colonel, and his career includes working as vice president of administration and legislative affairs at Utah Valley University.
Peterson was a state and county delegate in the Republican Party and was finance chair of the Utah County Republican Party in 2009.
He has served in the Utah House since 2011, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Education Committee and of the Business and Labor Committee in earlier sessions.
